title: Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.28764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. translated_title: 用于扩散模型测试时多偏好对齐的对比梯度引导
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28764v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：将预训练的扩散模型与多个依赖上下文的偏好进行对齐，需要在测试时对生成过程进行自适应调整，而不是依赖离线微调——后者需要对每个偏好权衡进行超参数调优并重新训练。现有方法将多样化的偏好压缩为单一的标量奖励目标，用于微调或测试时引导，而不是直接复用那些为不同目的发布、并通过不同微调方法获得的现成生成专家模型。在这项工作中，我们提出了对比梯度引导，这是一个测试时的组合式生成框架，将多偏好对齐问题重新表述为分布的组合。CGG 将每个偏好表示为一个对比偏好对，即受青睐的专家模型与不受青睐的反专家模型，两者得分之差构成对比梯度引导信号，该信号结合了来自现成（去噪方向/梯度）……
tldr: 提出对比梯度引导（CGG），一种测试时组合式生成框架，通过将每个偏好表示为“专家-反专家”对比偏好对、并利用两者得分差作为引导信号，把扩散模型的多偏好对齐重新表述为分布组合，从而无需离线微调即可在测试时灵活对齐多个偏好。
en_tdlr: Proposes Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment of diffusion models as distribution composition, representing each preference as an expert-anti-expert contrastive pair whose score difference serves as a guidance signal, enabling flexible test-time alignment without offline fine-tuning.
